item.title: Takeda PID asset Phase 2 win
item.description:
• Summary: Takeda announced positive Phase 2 results for its investigational primary immunodeficiency (PID) therapy, demonstrating improved convenience compared to HyQvia. The asset, a subcutaneous immunoglobulin, showed non-inferior efficacy with fewer infusion sites and shorter administration times, potentially offering a more patient-friendly option for PID patients.
  • MoAs: Immunoglobulin replacement therapy; provides passive immunity through subcutaneous administration of polyclonal antibodies.
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech

item.title: Windward Bio long-acting TSLP antibody funding
item.description:
• Summary: Windward Bio raised $165 million in Series B financing to support the Phase 3 development of a long-acting anti-TSLP antibody for asthma. The drug, derived from a Chinese biotech, is designed to require less frequent dosing. The funding round was led by new and existing investors, positioning Windward Bio to compete in the respiratory biologics market.
  • MoAs: TSLP antagonist; inhibits thymic stromal lymphopoietin, a key cytokine in type 2 inflammation, thereby reducing asthma exacerbations.
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech, Endpoints News
